name: first_aid
objective: Which potion are you crafting first? Source: Icy Veins First Aid guide.
pages: In WoW: Forever healing potions are made with First Aid, not Alchemy.
First Aid is a secondary profession, so every character can learn it.
Potions share a 2-minute cooldown. Bandages still work as before.
Every potion needs an herb, a vial and spices.
Skill 1. Heals 70-90. Peacebloom, Empty Vial, Mild Spices.
Skill 55. Heals 140-180. Briarthorn, Empty Vial, Mild Spices.
Skill 110. Heals 280-360. Bruiseweed, Leaded Vial, Hot Spices.
Skill 155. Heals 455-585. Manual drops from a Syndicate Mercenary in Arathi Highlands.
Skill 215. Heals 700-900. Learned from its manual.
Skill 275. Heals 1,050-1,750. Manual sold by Pexmit in Mount Hyjal.
Remove poisons, usable in combat. From Anti-Venom at 80 up to Powerful Anti-Venom at 300 (Argent Dawn, Honored).
Remove diseases, out of combat. Simple Poultice at 90 from the trainer.
Remove bleeds, out of combat. Woolen Tourniquet at 120 from the trainer.
Heavy Runecloth Bandage: 290 skill to make, heals 2,000 over 8 seconds.
Any First Aid trainer, up to 75 and 150 skill.
Buy Expert First Aid - Under Wraps at 125 skill: Deneb Walker, Stromgarde (Alliance) or Balai Lok'Wein, Brackenwall (Horde).
Level 35 and 225 skill. Quest "Triage" in Theramore (Alliance) or Hammerfall (Horde).
Campfire item: Stamina buff up to +56 at level 60. Does not stack with Fortitude.
